# Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO

 Jun 23, 2026 

Marc DeBevoise has been appointed CEO of OverDrive, succeeding founder Steve Potash in the role, the digital content provider announced today. The leadership transition was planned and is “designed to support OverDrive's continued growth and global expansion," per an announcement. 

DeBevoise, who previously held leadership roles at video platform Brightcove and online content network CBS Interactive, first joined Overdrive earlier this year as president. 

"Founding and building OverDrive has been the most rewarding journey of my career," said Potash, who will stay on as chairman of the board, said in a statement. "With Marc leading as CEO, the company is exceptionally well positioned to grow and evolve. As Chairman, I look forward to supporting Marc and our team while continuing to champion the libraries, schools, and institutions at the heart of our mission."
